findings.title: Including I18n::Backend::Fallbacks into I18n::Backend::Simple breaks lazy loading of fallback locales
findings.body: `config/initializers/i18n.rb` includes `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` into `I18n.backend.class` (`I18n::Backend::Simple`), while `lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb` only ensures the primary `config.locale` is loaded when `I18n.translate` is called (and `ApplicationController#set_locale` only runs during controller requests, not in background jobs, mailers, rake tasks, or specs, nor when `I18n.t(key, locale: ...)` is called with an explicit locale). When a translation is missing in the primary locale and falls back to `SiteSetting.default_locale` or `:en`, `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks#translate` iterates over `I18n.fallbacks[locale]` and calls `super` directly on the backend, bypassing `I18n.translate` and its `load_locale` hook. If a fallback locale has not been loaded yet, the backend has no translations for it in memory and the lookup fails with `I18n::MissingTranslationData` instead of returning the fallback translation.

findings.title: Translation cache is not invalidated when SiteSetting.default_locale changes
findings.body: `I18n.translate` caches results in `@cache` keyed only by `"#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}"`. With `FallbackLocaleList` now dynamically resolving fallbacks using `SiteSetting.default_locale`, changing `SiteSetting.default_locale` at runtime will not invalidate `@cache`, so previously cached fallback translations for a user's locale will continue to serve values from the old `default_locale` (or cached values from before a fallback locale was loaded).

findings.title: No specs added for fallback locale resolution or FallbackLocaleList
findings.body: This PR introduces custom server-side locale fallback behavior (`FallbackLocaleList`, `I18n.ensure_loaded!`, and controller integration) without any unit or integration tests verifying that missing translations fall back from user locale to `SiteSetting.default_locale` and then to `:en`.
